description: Deploy a game and get a playable multiplayer URL (keyless if no projectId). Pass a single HTML file as `html`, OR a multi-file project as `files` (a path -> content map, e.g. index.html + game.js + styles.css; binary assets as data: URIs). Write the game against the antics SDK first — call get_docs if you haven't.

entry.description: Entry file path when it is not index.html.

files.description: Multi-file project: { "index.html": "...", "game.js": "...", "styles.css": "..." }. Entry is index.html unless `entry` is set.

html.description: The full HTML of a single-file game.

name: deploy_game
